name: NY-09
label: Safe D

key_factors: Strong Democratic district with a +22 partisan lean
Incumbent Yvette Clarke running for re-election
Republican challenger Joel Azumah shows no fundraising or outside support
Prediction markets price Clarke's win at roughly 95%
model.rationale: The +22 Democratic lean, Clarke's incumbency, and her large fundraising edge over an underfunded challenger all point to a comfortable win, and markets agree at about 95%. With no polls or expert ratings available, uncertainty stays elevated but not enough to move the race off Safe D.
model.watch: Any late polling or unexpected challenger spending could narrow the margin, though an upset remains very unlikely.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview:
Brooklyn's NY-09 is a heavily Democratic district with a +22 partisan lean, and incumbent Yvette Clarke is seeking re-election after easily securing her party's nomination. Clarke has raised over $1 million and holds a large financial advantage, with outside groups adding support and none opposing her.

Republican Joel Azumah reports no fundraising or outside backing, and prediction markets price Clarke's chances at roughly 95%. No public polls or expert ratings cover the race, so uncertainty is somewhat elevated, but every available signal points to a comfortable Democratic hold.
